Diamond & Pearl series · LA

Legends Awakened

Released August 1, 2008 · 146 cards

Legends Awakened is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on August 1, 2008. It has 146 cards. It includes 135 Pokémon, 11 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

22 illustrators worked on Legends Awakened. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (23), Kent Kanetsuna (16), Kouki Saitou (16), Kazuaki Aihara (12), Masakazu Fukuda (12), Ryo Ueda (11), Atsuko Nishida (9), Midori Harada (9).
